test_pybind11_methods_and_attributes: test pybind11 bound C++ methods and attributes including overloaded functions and value manipulation
test_pybind11_properties: test pybind11 readonly, readwrite, and writeonly property bindings on C++ classes exposed to Python
test_pybind11_static_properties: test pybind11 static property bindings including readonly, readwrite, and writeonly static attributes
test_pybind11_dynamic_attributes: test pybind11 dynamic attribute assignment and __dict__ access on C++ classes exposed to Python
test_pybind11_cyclic_gc: test pybind11 garbage collection of cyclic references between dynamically attributed C++ objects
